fields.title: Kerala Monsoon Flood Relief 2024 - Ground Operations
fields.description: Urgent volunteer mobilization for flood relief work in Wayanad district. Tasks include rescue operations support, relief material distribution, setting up temporary shelters, and providing medical assistance.

fields.title: Educational Materials for Orphanage - Teaching Support
fields.description: Long-term volunteer program to provide educational support to orphanage children. Looking for volunteers who can teach various subjects, conduct workshops, and mentor children.

fields.title: Emergency Medical Supplies for Kochi - Medical Camp Staffing
fields.description: Monthly mobile medical camps across rural areas of Kerala. Need volunteers with medical background, pharmacy knowledge, and general support staff for patient registration and crowd management.

fields.title: Winter Clothes Distribution Drive - Logistics Volunteers
fields.description: Logistics and distribution support for the winter clothing drive. Volunteers will help sort collected clothes and manage distribution points in Thiruvananthapuram.
